API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APILocation ManagementLocations Group Resource Get Groups Count
Locations Group Resource Get Groups Count
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/locations/groups/count

Gets the list of location groups for your organization.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
lastModUser
string

The admin who modified the location group last.

version
int32

The version parameter is for Zscaler internal use only. The version is used by the service for backup operations.

Default value: 0
name
string

The location group's name.

groupType
string

The location group's type (i.e., Static or Dynamic).

comments
string

Additional comments or information about the location group.

locationId
int32

The unique identifier for a location within a location group.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
SCHEMA
integer
int32
